title: Age, health and helping older people
summary: At 71 he wonders how long he will live and says he helps older people across the street.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: To play for 53 years and to continue to play make'me wonder how old I'm going to get. I don't know...I'm 71 now. I'm in my 72nd year. Maybe I'm going to follow Eubie Blake. I don't need my glasses to read...I don't use my glasses to read.

And I always find myself helping older people across the street. Older people. I'm 71...somebody fifty, and I'm helping them across. I'm always concerned with people. Now, am I going to live to be 100?
